describes: packages/plugin/stamp: armAsset and disarm through the annotation plugin, and dynamic stamps through form scripting.

cases.name: arm-delegates-to-the-annotation-plugin
cases.covers: armAsset hands the target document's annotation plugin the asset's placement bytes, its preview as a payload, its intrinsic size and the target width; disarm disarms that document's stamp.

cases.name: a-raster-asset-arms-with-its-own-preview
cases.covers: A loose raster asset arms with its bytes and itself as the preview; a PDF asset with no preview arms without one.

cases.name: arming-what-is-not-there
cases.covers: An unknown asset rejects with NotFound before anything else; a document with no annotation plugin, or one that is not open, rejects (arm) or throws (disarm) with the kernel's missing-capability error.

cases.name: scripting-off-arms-the-template
cases.covers: With scripting disabled, or enabled on a host with no sandbox, a PDF asset arms its template bytes and no copy is opened.

cases.name: no-sandbox-host
cases.covers: A host with scripting enabled but no sandbox evaluates nothing: the Rust port has no scripting options to build, and the TypeScript runs as with scripting disabled.

cases.name: a-raster-asset-is-never-evaluated
cases.covers: With scripting enabled, a raster asset still arms as is, without a target check.

cases.name: a-stamp-without-fields-on-its-page-arms-the-template
cases.covers: A copy whose form has no widget on the selected page is closed again and the template bytes arm; a field on another page does not count.

cases.name: materializes-a-dynamic-stamp
cases.covers: With scripting enabled, a canonical asset's whole library PDF opens as a detached copy under the target's identity; the standalone controller boots and recalculates it against the target document with the configured clock, offset and seed; the page is flattened for display, extracted and rendered without annotations, and that page and preview arm. The library and template bytes stay as they were.

cases.name: a-loose-dynamic-stamp
cases.covers: A loose PDF asset evaluates from its own bytes and must be exactly one page: a single page is selected whatever its number, two pages reject with InvalidArg. A target without an identity opens the copy without one.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] a loose dynamic stamp asset must contain exactly one page

cases.name: dynamic-stamp-refusals
cases.covers: A target that is not open rejects with NotFound before any copy; a canonical page missing from the copy rejects with InvalidArg naming it; an engine without pages.flatten or pages.extract rejects with NotImplemented. Each copy is closed.

cases.name: a-failed-boot-script-is-a-diagnostic
cases.covers: A boot script that throws does not fail the recalculation: its UI effects and diagnostics (the failure among them) reach the observers, onError is not called, and the stamp still materializes.

args.message: Document boot script failed (continuing without it): boom

cases.name: a-failed-recalculation-fails-the-arm
cases.covers: A recalculation that fails (here over its effect budget) surfaces its effects, diagnostics and error to the observers, then rejects with Unknown naming the script error; the controller is disposed, the copy closed, and nothing arms.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] dynamic stamp scripting failed: Form script transaction exceeded 1 effects

cases.name: an-error-observer-that-throws
cases.covers: An onError observer that throws is reported to console.error; the failed recalculation still rejects the arm.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] dynamic stamp scripting failed: Form script transaction exceeded 0 effects

$error.name: TypeError
$error.message: observer is not ready

cases.name: observers-see-a-successful-run
cases.covers: A successful run surfaces its UI effects and diagnostics too; an observer that throws is reported to console.error and stops the rest, and the arm still goes ahead.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: observer broke

cases.name: a-flatten-that-fails-or-skips
cases.covers: A flatten result that failed or was skipped rejects with Unknown naming its page; the copy is closed.

cases.name: a-failed-copy-close-fails-the-arm
cases.covers: A copy whose close rejects fails the arm with that error even after a successful evaluation; a URL-sourced render of the flattened page rejects with NotImplemented.

cases.name: a-loose-pdf-under-a-canonical-id-has-no-page
cases.covers: A loose PDF asset whose library id an import later took evaluates from the canonical bytes, where it has no page: with more than one page the arm rejects with InvalidArg naming an unknown page.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] canonical page unknown no longer exists

cases.name: a-library-without-canonical-bytes
cases.covers: When the library's save answered nothing, a dynamic asset evaluates from its own extracted page. An asset whose extraction answered nothing opens an empty copy, and when that copy has no field on its page it arms no bytes, which the annotation plugin refuses.

$error.name: TypeError
$error.message: Cannot destructure property 'data' of 'source' as it is undefined.

cases.name: teardown-destroys-a-factory-engine-once
cases.covers: A materialization through a factory engine uses the memoized engine, and teardown destroys it.
